_comment: Golden for conversationToMarkdown (webui src/lib/export.ts) and export::to_markdown (cctui-tui). Every category is visible, so both sides render every block. Tool inputs keep their keys in alphabetical order: serde_json sorts object keys and JSON.stringify preserves insertion order, so only an already-sorted input is byte-identical on both sides. Note the single newline between the meta line and the first block: conversationToMarkdown joins its header with one separator there, and byte-identical means matching that.
